title: Degree bound for the coefficient polynomial
statement: For every natural number $\ell$ and every coefficient vector $a\in\mathbb F_2^\ell$, the degree of $\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}a_iX^i$ is strictly less than $\ell$.
